elements.text: I wanted to meet women who inspired me and spend time with them. I love Milan, but I was tired of always having to appear perfectly in control. My profile was growing through the articles I shared, and I used it to ask people to meet. That was the beginning: an invitation.

elements.text: Because otherwise the title does the introduction for you. I know how it feels to be judged by the job you have at that moment. Before starting my company, I worked as a shop assistant and did other jobs. That experience stayed with me. At TLWC, you begin with your name. Then people ask questions, guess, get curious. It becomes a game. I have seen very reserved people open up, laugh and share things that their closest friends had never heard.
